Versioned app-shell/runtime caches precache core public routes/assets; navigation is network-first with cached/offline fallback; static image/style/font assets are cache-first with background refresh; /api and /__/ are excluded.
Install uses skipWaiting; activate deletes caches outside current app/runtime cache names and claims clients.
New service worker activates immediately and claims clients; navigation fetch remains network-first so deployed routes are refreshed before cached fallback.
Permission is requested only through explicit browser notification enrollment; iOS non-standalone state is detected and reported as not granted/needs install.
Foreground onMessage dispatches notification sync, suppresses auto-FCM payloads, and calls showBrowserNotification with deterministic id/tag metadata.
Background onBackgroundMessage suppresses FCM auto-display payloads unless manual-service-worker mode is declared, then shows a manually tagged notification.
Drop/server notifications use deterministic idempotency keys/document ids; foreground/background browser display resolves deterministic tags and uses renotify=false.

notificationclick closes the alert, sanitizes target URLs to same-origin routes, focuses/navigates matching clients or opens a new window, and posts click metadata so the app can mark notifications read.

Web FCM token is obtained through getToken during explicit enrollment and persisted through /api/user/profile. Firebase Web SDK has no onTokenRefresh listener in the current modular API; re-enrollment/getToken is the supported refresh path.
